description:
System tray app to hide/show desktop icons, taskbar, and windows via hotkeys.

HideDesktopApps is a lightweight Windows system tray utility that lets you
instantly hide and show desktop icons, the taskbar, and all open application
windows using configurable global hotkeys. Useful for ricing, revealing a
wallpaper, screen sharing, or cleaning up the desktop for a presentation.
Written in Rust as a single native binary with no runtime dependency.
